Any changes in the tender/addendum/corrigendum shall be published in the Eprocurement Portal Only
The APS for Unbalanced Tenders as per circular no UDD 410 SaMaSA 2017 dated 20.02.2018 and GO No FD 456 Exp-12/2022 dated 10/08/2022

Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bi

The Tenderer shall scan Original Workdone certificates / Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening.
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
